scope_note: Vietnam national daytime pilot; no diocesan overlay. Only the listed source-backed decisions are supported. Underlying Roman General dates are calculation context, never a national fallback. No Gospel mapping is approved here.

decisions.celebration: Mồng Hai Tết – Kính nhớ tổ tiên và ông bà cha mẹ
decisions.note: National directive item 1 assigns this Mass. Lent and Ash Wednesday Hours still begin on February 18; do not transfer the season.

decisions.celebration: Mồng Ba Tết – Thánh hóa công ăn việc làm
decisions.note: National directive item 2 assigns this Mass, not the ordinary Thursday-after-Ash Mass.
National directive item 3 assigns the Ash Mass and ashes, fasting and abstinence. This does not move the beginning of Lent or the Hours.
The national 2026 proclamation explicitly names Easter on April 5. Default daytime only; no Easter Vigil or evening variant is selected.
The national 2026 proclamation explicitly names Pentecost on May 24. Default daytime only, not the vigil.

decisions.celebration: Mình và Máu Thánh Chúa Kitô
decisions.note: The national 2026 proclamation names Corpus Christi on June 7. Select that Mass without claiming an all-years transfer law or a national liturgical rank from this template alone.
National directive section II.2 requires All Saints on November 1, superseding Ordinary Sunday 31. October 31 evening is outside the implemented daytime option.

decisions.celebration: Đức Giêsu Kitô Vua Vũ Trụ
decisions.note: The national 2026 proclamation explicitly names Christ the King on November 22.
The national 2026 proclamation explicitly names Advent I on November 29. Its new Sunday cycle must come from that date, not the civil year's earlier Sundays.
